symptoms: Dark brown spots with concentric rings, like a target
A yellow halo around each spot
Lowest leaves turn yellow and drop first
Sunken dark lesions on stems near the soil
data.summary: A fungal leaf spot that starts on the oldest leaves and climbs the plant.

immediate: Pick off and destroy the worst affected lower leaves
Mulch the soil surface to stop spores splashing up
cultural: Improve air movement by pruning the lowest 30 cm of foliage
Feed a balanced dose of nitrogen; starved plants collapse faster
biological: Trichoderma viride or T. harzianum as a soil drench and foliar spray
Bacillus subtilis based biofungicide every 7-10 days
chemical: Protectant: mancozeb 75% WP, about 2 g per litre of water
Curative: azoxystrobin 23% SC, about 1 ml per litre
Alternate the two so the fungus does not build resistance
preventive: Rotate away from tomato, potato and brinjal for 2-3 seasons
Stake plants and space them so leaves dry quickly after rain
Irrigate at the base, never over the leaves
Remove and burn crop residue after harvest

data.expertAdvice: Contact your Krishi Vigyan Kendra or state agriculture officer if the affected area doubles within a week of treatment, if more than a quarter of the field is affected, or if you are unsure about this result.

disclaimer: AI-based detection is an assistance tool and may not always be accurate. For serious crop damage or uncertain results, consult a qualified agricultural expert. Follow local agricultural recommendations and product labels before applying any treatment.
